text:
rachel_marketing: Small creative request for next inbound push — need 4 benchmark tiles + 2 webinar hero frames. Two colorways (ocean / slate), light + dark, localized EN-US / EN-GB / FR. Target publish Monday.

anya_design: We can take this. Quick questions: final headlines ready? Do you want illustrations or abstract shapes?

rachel_marketing: Headlines are drafts in the brief: 'Lower latency, lower cost' (short) + longer variant in the doc. Prefer simple vector illustrations (no partner logos).

tom_creative: Suggest adding a tiny data sparkline in corner to hint at bench data — small, non-technical. I can add three-point SVG sparklines.

ada_legal: Legal flag: avoid unverified superlatives. If copy mentions comparisons, include data source doc link. All images need alt text. We'll sign off on copy once drafts land.

ops-bot: Reminder: use naming convention campaign_region_variant_lang_size.png. Example: inbound_na_ocean_en-US_tile1200x800.png.

anya_design: Thanks. Locking sizes: tile 1200x800, social 1080x1080, hero 1920x1080 + email 800x1000. Export PNG final, SVG icons, layered Figma. Safe margin 48px, provide light + dark exports and contrast notes.

mia_ops: I can ingest assets if you provide a CSV: filename, campaign_id, region, language, publish_date. Please include alt_text column.

rachel_marketing: I'll upload copy variants and campaign IDs to the brief now. Delivery timeline: drafts Wed morning, internal review Wed afternoon, legal Thu morning, marketing final Thu midday.

anya_design: We'll mock both short + long headlines per language and both themes. Figma link posted with first drafts Wed AM.

tom_creative: I'll prepare SVG sparklines and a tiny micro-icon set (arrow, spark, shield) as tokenized SVGs.

ada_legal: I'll review copy Thu morning. If any comparative claims appear, attach the supporting doc.

rachel_marketing: Thanks everyone — call out any blockers now. If extra paid sizes are needed (stories), mention them before Wed draft push. :rocket:
